<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" agent="Antigravity"> <diagram name="RAG-Pipeline" id="rag_pipeline_diag"> <mxGraphModel dx="1200" dy="800" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="960" pageHeight="560" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" />

<mxCell id="group_query" value="Phase 2: Runtime Retrieval &amp; Generation" style="swimlane;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;startSize=26;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="630" y="30" width="280" height="480" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="user_q" value="<b>Customer Tech Query</b><br><font style="font-size: 11px;">&quot;How do I reset Quantum Processor 9?&quot;</font>" style="shape=parallelogram;perimeter=parallelogramPerimeter;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fixedSize=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;" vertex="1" parent="group_query"> <mxGeometry style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;endArrow=classic;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="e_store" edge="1" parent="1" source="embedder" target="vector_db" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;endArrow=classic;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="300" y="442" /> <mxPoint x="300" y="270" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_store" value="Index Vectors" style="edgeLabel;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=10;fontColor=#000000;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" connectable="0" parent="e_store"> <mxGeometry x="0.1" y="2" relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="e_search" edge="1" parent="1" source="tool_rag" target="vector_db" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;endArrow=classic;startArrow=classic;startFill=1;entryX=1;entryY=0.5;exitX=0;exitY=0.5;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="600" y="312" /> <mxPoint x="600" y="270" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_search" value="Query &amp; Retrieve (k=3)" style="edgeLabel;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=10;fontColor=#000000;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" connectable="0" parent="e_search"> <mxGeometry x="-0.1" y="-3" relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
</root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
